description: Fetch one World Heritage site's full record by id_no: its description, statement of Outstanding Universal Value, each inscription criterion with its meaning (criterion (vi) marked as inferred), States Parties, coordinates, area, inscription and later years, Danger-list year, component parts, names in six languages, and the main image with its copyright credit. Intangible heritage UNESCO links to the site is listed by unesco_search_intangible_heritage with world_heritage_site.

id_no.description: The site's World Heritage id_no, from unesco_search_sites. A number, a digit string, or the site's whc.unesco.org/en/list/{id} page URL.

max_components.description: Maximum component parts to list (0–1000, default 20). 0 omits the list but keeps components_total; the largest site has 758 components.

name: unesco_get_site

components.description: Component parts in UNESCO order, up to max_components.

name.description: Component name; absent when UNESCO lists none.

components_total.description: UNESCO's component count for the site.

components_unparsed.description: Entries of UNESCO's component list that could not be read and are omitted; 0 normally.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes aligned with states; empty for the one site without a code.

meaning.description: The criterion's meaning, paraphrased from UNESCO's Operational Guidelines.

source.description: recorded: from UNESCO's criteria field. inferred: named by the statement of Outstanding Universal Value (criterion (vi), which UNESCO's criteria fields omit).

danger_listed_year.description: Year of the site's current Danger-list entry, when in danger.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `site_not_found`: No record carries this id_no. `snapshot_unavailable`: No World Heritage snapshot has loaded yet and the Data Hub is unreachable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

image.description: Main image with its credit, when UNESCO lists one.

url.description: Main image URL (opens in a browser; not fetched by this server).

in_danger.description: True when the site is on the List of World Heritage in Danger.

justification.description: The statement of Outstanding Universal Value, when recorded.

names.description: Names in the other UNESCO languages, each present when UNESCO records it.

notice.description: How to list more components, or why some are missing.

secondary_years.description: Later years UNESCO's secondary dates list for the site after inscription; empty when none.

sources.description: Datasets this response was built from.

attribution.description: Credit line to reproduce with the data.

data_as_of.description: Dataset's data_processed timestamp (ISO 8601) from the loaded snapshot.

license.description: Dataset license from the dataset metadata ('CC BY-SA 4.0').

states.description: States Parties as UNESCO names them.

transboundary.description: True when the site spans more than one State Party.

truncated.description: True when the component list was capped at max_components.

title: Get World Heritage site
